summary.text: Customers find the table runner to be of good quality and perfect for fall decor, with one customer noting its beautiful rusty orange color with leaves imprinted throughout. They consider it worth the cost and appreciate its durability. The length receives mixed feedback, with some finding it great while others say it's too short. The material and thickness also get mixed reviews, with some describing it as nice while others find it not thick enough.

authors_reviews.title: Perfect for fall decorating
authors_reviews.text: This is exactly what I wanted. The color is not "in your face" but muted and perfect fall color. It is lacy material, and not thick. The size is spot on and I am very happy with the cost. Great for fall, and I plan to use it through Thanksgiving.

authors_reviews.title: Pretty design
authors_reviews.text: This is perfect for fall! It’s thin and see through which helps bring out the wood of my table. The size is accurate and gives plenty of slack to adjust when needed. The color is a nice autumn color. Not too bright but not too dark. It’s super durable and easy to clean!Definitely worth it to bring some fall to your table!
